name: M5: what M4 left open, families 1, 6 and 14 at k = 0 and family 15 at both rungs, on a third confirmatory run
status: frozen on 2026-11-23 on the decision the author delegated, before any confirmatory world of the run is fitted

scope.chosen: S0, only what M4 left open (2026-11-23)

arms.tested: anchored floored, family 15 only, not routed

standing.M4: its 26 verdicts, 11 at k = 0 and 15 at the tested rung, read again nowhere
standing.M3: its six verdicts on the geo families 8, 9 and 10

not run.4 at k = 0: M3 and M4 read it: margin held trails PyMC-Marketing and Orbit by about 0.17 a euro, and a search for a k = 0 rule within the margin on family 4 found none
not run.8, 9, 10: the geo families: M3's verdicts stand
not run.11: withdrawn: the public endogenous-spend reference instance replaced AMSS as the third-party world
not run.16: that reference instance's files have not come
not run.21: a set of answer keys for contribution readings, not a family the scorecard plans

not taken.S1: the k = 0 rung of every national family: 11 verdicts M4 confirmed read again, and in a fixed sequence a chance failure among them would end the new verdicts after it; about four times S0's core-hours

claim.multiplicity: a fixed sequence over the verdicts that claim a comparison, each at 0.025 in the declared order; the first that does not hold ends the confirmatory claims, every later verdict read and printed not confirmed
claim.order rule: each family and rung that claims a comparison and is not exploratory, by its predictive on the sizing records, every claimed comparison within together, highest first; ties by family, then rung
claim.headline: against each rival at its recommended settings, over M5's five verdicts, M4's 26 and M3's six geo verdicts together: every family and rung claimed whole, none predicted to fail, every verdict holds at 0.025, an intersection-union test with no adjustment; it cannot be said: family 4 at k = 0 is not claimed
claim.comparison reads: complete cases; an environment where the rival failed on more than half of the worlds is not compared; the status quo standing in for every failed plan printed beside it as a secondary readout

secondary.past bounds: every stage of every fit, the two-stage arm's first stage included
gain at k = 0: the best plan less the status quo

seeds.confirmatory: causaldyn_bench.scorecard.family.confirmatory(family, third=True): family f's e-th environment, e counted in the bench's order of the family's environments, from 1000000 + 20000 f + 1000 e, a block of its own; the first worlds an environment of it, indexed from 0
seeds.family 15's files: siMMMulator 1.1.0 through the bench's scripts/simmmulator_worlds.R for seeds 1300000 to 1300239, written before the freeze; the pinned bench holds each file's SHA-256 and reads no other
seeds.outside: every pilot, scored and confirmatory block, both earlier confirmatory runs, every seed a committed run drew, family 15's recorded files and the development ranges 700000-899999; bench tests/test_scorecard_seeds.py

sizing records.roots: M4's scored roots f1, f6 and f14 at k = 0 (exploratory in M4, every rival fitted); family 15: M3's e0-f15 and et-f15, M2's 100 recorded worlds with M2's rival records, anchored floored from round 8's rows
sizing records.chosen on these records: margin held was frozen before M2; anchored floored was chosen on family 15's records among others (round 8's development set), so its predictive there can be optimistic

sizing.rule: each comparison sized from its own sizing mean m, SD s and pairs n: the fewest N, in tens, at which the calibrated predictive Phi((margin - m - z s / sqrt(N)) / (s sqrt(1/n + 1/N))) reaches the power, z = z(0.975); N = ((z^2 - q^2) / (a z - q sqrt(a^2 + (z^2 - q^2) / n)))^2, a = (margin - m) / s, q = z(power), where a > q / sqrt(n); a comparison with m >= margin is not sized; the rung needs the largest N over its sized comparisons, at least the floor; past the cap, exploratory
sizing.reader's check: the rung's N raised by ten worlds while one sized comparison's bootstrap predictive (Hall's reader, as the claim reads) is below the power
sizing.tie rule: M4's, printed beside it and not taken: N = (2.8016 sd / margin)^2, the largest over the rung's comparisons
sizing.family: the largest of its claimed rungs' worlds, at least the floor, split evenly over its environments and rounded up

predictive.records: the sizing records, every complete case
stages: worlds drawn with replacement, as many as each environment holds
the declared worlds an environment drawn from those
predictive.failed fit: drawn and left out of the comparison's complete cases, as the claim reads it

sizing.checked in Maxima: the convolution, the root, its limit (the tie rule at m = 0) and P(N) = power at six points

arms.k = 0: margin held, the margin arm's variant, M4's claim arm unchanged
arms.tested rung: anchored floored on family 15 alone (ADR 0097), M4's claim arm unchanged
recorded: margin, margin guarded, margin ranged, margin curved and margin curved noise, from the same process
anchored, anchored curved and anchored held on family 15, from the same process

rivals.meridian: 2.1.0, recommended settings (roi priors, automatic knot selection)
rivals.pymc-marketing: 1.3.0, logistic saturation, static intercept, 4 chains named

deviations from M4: a third confirmatory run (bench third_confirmatory, mixdyn Declaration.third_confirmatory, ADR 0101): a block an environment
the sizing rule: each comparison from its own mean and SD with the sizing mean's error carried, checked by the claim's reader; M4's tie rule printed beside it
the sizing records of families 1, 6 and 14 are M4's scored records
family 15 in the claim at both rungs on fresh siMMMulator files of the third run's block
only what M4 left open is run: families 1, 6 and 14 at k = 0 and family 15; family 4 at k = 0 is not run
ridge and chc are not run

pins.mixdyn: the commit that marks this file frozen; its arms are those of 0.2.1, whose tree planned M4's records again bit for bit
pins.bench: bc52170ac9c4069d9f843c0d7c45584c6320bcc3, on its branch m5-draft over main d92c1ea, with the third run's seeds and family 15's digests of the third run's files

limits.rule: M2's memory cap and timeout of the arm's cost class on the family its cost is read from (families 12, 13 and 17-20 family 0's), the timeout stretched by the arm's cost factor; the class's slots and CPUs a process; family 15's from M2's records of family 15

compute.from: the run kit's cost model (scripts/cost.py, scripts/schedule.py) on the declared worlds, M2's recorded CPU a process, one simulation on one 192-CPU box: a planning figure, not a timing; it put M4 at 1868 core-hours and 19.2 hours for a realised 1502 and 16.0
compute.box hours: makespan x 1.075 (spot stops) + 0.5 to provision + 0.5 to pull

budget.set: 2026-11-23, on the decision the author delegated
budget.worst case: the hard stop plus an hour at the bid with the address, a 200 GiB gp3 volume for 5 days, the image's snapshot for a month and 30 GB out, as in M4
